verdict.rationale: dlt ships a local DuckDB destination and its tutorials run pipelines on a laptop against it. Users can then inspect the loaded dataset via pipeline.dataset(). The docs also say the destination can be switched without modifying pipeline code, which covers the local-to-production promotion. Missing for 10: documented testing tooling or guidance for validating pipelines before production, and independent hands-on corroboration of the local-dev-then-promote workflow.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I run and test a pipeline locally against a lightweight destination before it touches production

citations.quote: let's load a list of Python dictionaries into DuckDB and inspect the created dataset
This approach is especially useful when switching between destinations without modifying the actual pipeline code.
